name: Hedra
tagline: Turn a photo and voice into talking, expressive characters.
description: Hedra generates lip-synced, expressive talking-character video from a single image plus audio or a script. Its Character-3 model handles facial performance and emotion, and a Live Avatars tier streams those characters in real time for conversational AI agents.
insight: The app behind viral "talking baby podcasts"; raised a $32M a16z-led Series A in May 2025 at a ~$200M valuation.
edge: Real-time Live Avatars stream lip-synced talking heads at sub-100ms latency, giving voice agents a face cheaply.
